FortressTV 2.0.0-RC16

Trakt.tv Integration:
- Trakt OAuth with RFC 7636 PKCE browser flow (one-tap authorization via fortresstv://trakt/callback).
- Device code pairing with QR code and Android TV D-pad focus highlight.
- Secure AndroidKeyStore AES-256 GCM token storage scoped to household profiles.
- Real-time VOD scrobbler for movies and series with TMDB/IMDB verification, pause debounce, and buffering exclusion.
- Full English and Portuguese (pt-PT) localization.

Architecture & Refactoring:
- Complete modular split of MainActivity into dedicated feature screens.
- Extracted lifecycle-owned workflows (SourceSync, EpgSync, SecurityLock, PlaybackOrchestration).
